name: Matthias Ecke - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on a coherent tax framework for the EU's financial sector
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to rethink how the financial sector is taxed. It wants a review of the long-standing rule that exempts banks and insurers from value added tax, a tax added to the price of goods and services. It also wants simpler, more coordinated rules across member states, and a study of whether insurance taxes could be folded into the value added tax system. This is an opinion; no law changes yet.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to review and possibly propose reforms.
- **Who it affects:** Banks, insurers, fintech firms, savers and consumers across the EU.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to act; any tax change needs all member states to agree.
